news.title: Forecast to breakeven in 2029
news.body: The 7 analysts covering Ather Energy expect the company to break even for the first time. New consensus forecast suggests the company will make a profit of ₹2.88b in 2029. Average annual earnings growth of 64% is required to achieve expected profit on schedule.

news.title: Ather Energy Limited Appoints Ms. Surabhi Loshali as Chief Human Resources Officer, Effective January 5, 2026
news.body: Ather Energy Limited appointed Ms. Surabhi Loshali as Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), Senior Management Personnel (SMP) of the Company, effective January 5, 2026. Ms. Surabhi brings over 20 years of experience in human resources leadership, with deep expertise in people strategy, organisation development, talent management, large scale transformation and people analytics and culture building across industries including pharmaceuticals, life sciences, manufacturing, technology, and financial services. She has held senior HR leadership roles at leading organisations, most recently serving as Group Chief Human Resources Officer at Strides Pharma Science Limited, where she led global people initiatives across multiple geographies. news.title: New minor risk - Profitability
news.body: The company is currently unprofitable and not forecast to become profitable over the next 3 years. Trailing 12-month net loss: ₹7.6b Forecast net loss in 3 years: ₹666m This is considered a minor risk. Companies that are not profitable are more likely to be burning through cash and less likely to be well established. Ultimately, shareholders want to see a good return on their investment and that generally comes from sharing in the company's profits. Without profits, the company is under pressure to grow significantly while potentially having to reduce costs and possibly needing to take on debt or raise capital to remain afloat.
